definitions.explanation: The body of law that defines criminal offenses and their punishments. In Japan, refers specifically to the Penal Code (刑法典) enacted in 1907.

examples.japanese: {刑法|けいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{刑法|けいほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{禁|きん}じられている→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧。
examples.english: That act is prohibited under criminal law.

examples.japanese: {刑法|けいほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改正案|かいせいあん}→改正案：20819_kaiseian⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A bill to amend the penal code is being deliberated in the Diet.

notes:
{刑法|けいほう} refers to the body of law defining crimes and punishments. In Japan, it specifically refers to the Penal Code ({刑法典|けいほうてん}) originally enacted in 1907.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刑法|けいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to violate criminal law
- {刑法|けいほう}⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧: penal code amendment
- {刑法|けいほう}{犯|はん}: criminal offense
- {刑法|けいほう}{学|がく}: criminal law studies

CONTRAST WITH OTHER LAWS:
- {刑法|けいほう}: criminal law (crimes and punishments)
- ⟦{民法|みんぽう}→民法：13239_minpou⟧: civil law (private disputes, contracts)
- ⟦{商法|しょうほう}→商法：30086_shouhou⟧: commercial law (business transactions)
- ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧: constitution (fundamental law of the state)

USAGE:
These four, along with {民事訴訟法|みんじそしょうほう} and {刑事訴訟法|けいじそしょうほう}, are known as Japan's ⟦{六法|ろっぽう}→六法：06612_roppou⟧ (Six Codes).
